whyMatters.en: London power trio (Clapton / Bruce / Baker) that pushed blues improvisation to hard-rock volume in 1966–68.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦三件套（Clapton / Bruce / Baker）：1966–68 把蓝调即兴推到 hard-rock 音量。

shortBio.en: Blues-rock power trio; Sunshine of Your Love is the classroom riff.
shortBio.zh: 蓝调摇滚三件套；Sunshine of Your Love 是课堂 riff。

body.en:
Formed 1966 after Clapton left the Yardbirds. Fresh Cream, Disraeli Gears, and Wheels of Fire document extended live jams, Bruce’s high vocal/bass, Baker’s jazz-informed drums.

Sunshine of Your Love (1967) and the live Crossroads are the citation tracks. Short career; lasting role as the bridge from British blues clubs to stadium-volume trio hard rock.
body.zh:
Clapton 离开 Yardbirds 后于 1966 年组建。Fresh Cream、Disraeli Gears 与 Wheels of Fire 记录长现场即兴、Bruce 的高音人声/贝斯、Baker 偏爵士的鼓。

Sunshine of Your Love（1967）与现场 Crossroads 是引用曲。生涯短；作用是英国蓝调俱乐部到体育场音量三件套 hard rock 的桥。
